title: Technological folie à deux: Feedback Loops Between AI Chatbots and Mental Health

bias_targets.target: Cognitive and Behavioral bias (Sycophancy and Belief Amplification)
bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-turn conversations between an LLM acting as a user with varying baseline paranoia and an LLM acting as a companion chatbot, then using an LLM-as-a-judge procedure to score the expressed paranoia in each utterance and applying time-lagged regression models to measure bidirectional belief amplification and sycophantic reinforcement.

primary_bias_target: Cognitive and Behavioral bias (Sycophancy and Belief Amplification)
